_strategy_note: Viral-first SEO content plan v11. Every topic follows the formula: RELATABLE PAIN or CURIOSITY GAP + SIMPLE EXPLANATION + SURPRISING FACT. Topics are chosen for (a) high YouTube search volume in India, (b) evergreen re-shareability, (c) conversation-starter potential in comments. Niches expanded from 2 to 5 to capture more algorithm surfaces.

why_things_work.system_prompt: Explain one everyday phenomenon or life mystery in a way that makes the viewer feel smart for understanding it. Target: 18-28 year old Indians who are curious and share interesting facts with friends. Format: short, punchy, conversational Indian English. The hook MUST make them stop scrolling. End with a surprising twist or fact they can tell someone else today.
topics: why your phone battery drains faster in cold weather
why yawning is contagious even through a screen
why we forget dreams within 10 minutes of waking up
why ice floats on water instead of sinking
why your voice sounds different in a recording versus in your head
why salt melts ice on roads but sugar doesn't work
why mirrors flip left-right but not up-down
why airplane windows have tiny holes in them
why hospitals smell the way they do
why your stomach growls when you're hungry
why we get goosebumps from music or cold
why the sea is salty but rivers are not
why onions make you cry and what actually happens in your eye
why we dream and what happens in the brain during REM sleep
why hot water can freeze faster than cold water (Mpemba effect)

exam_concepts.system_prompt: Create genuinely useful educational content for Indian competitive-exam aspirants (UPSC, SSC, NEET, JEE, Banking). Focus on one coherent concept. Explain the reasoning clearly. CRITICAL for virality: frame each topic as something the viewer can actually USE in their exam — give them the exact fact or framework they need to answer a question. End with a one-line memory trick. Natural conversational Indian English only.

why the difference between GDP and GNP matters more than you think
how to answer any Preamble question in UPSC in under 30 seconds
why Article 32 is called the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution

science_explainers.system_prompt: Explain one science concept in a way that creates a 'wow, I never knew that' moment. Perfect for students and curious people who share science facts. Start with something surprising that challenges what the viewer thinks they know. Use one perfect analogy. Target: NEET/JEE students and general science fans aged 16-25. Conversational Indian English, no jargon without an immediate simple explanation.

india_facts.system_prompt: Share one surprising, pride-inducing, or counterintuitive fact about India — its history, culture, science, economy or geography. These videos must be instantly shareable. Every Indian viewer should feel like they learned something about their own country they didn't know. Hook with the most surprising version of the fact. End with why it matters today. Conversational Indian English, warm and engaging tone.

how India's space program costs less than a Hollywood movie and still reaches Mars
why India has the most vegetarians in the world and what the health data says
the reason India has more than 19500 languages and dialects

mind_and_body.system_prompt: Explain one fascinating fact about how the human mind or body works — in a way that's directly useful for the viewer's daily life. These are the most-shared Shorts because everyone has a body and everyone wants to understand it better. Target: young Indians 18-30 who are health-conscious, exam-stressed, and curious. Make it feel like the viewer just learned a life hack from a doctor friend. Conversational Indian English, warm and relatable.
